scope: Local 2D layout screening thresholds, not publisher rules; measure on the final-size canvas.

scene_defaults.sparse_line: Try verified clear internal legend positions; reserve an outside key if none passes.
scene_defaults.dense_scatter_or_bars: Start with a dedicated legend row/column; do not cover observations or uncertainty.
scene_defaults.heatmap_or_image: Reserve a colorbar cell; tag intentional in-cell values or scale labels with a reason.
scene_defaults.multipanel: Use GridSpec, separate key/colorbar cells and aligned outer labels; check cross-panel intrusions.
scene_defaults.dense_point_labels: Use explicit leader annotations; optional adjustText only after final geometry, with fixed targets and bounded iterations.
